02 / Competencies

06 disciplines · grid 3×2

Full-stack, end to end — one accountable line.

Six disciplines, one partner. Every engagement starts at the system level and ends in production.

01

Design Systems

Token architecture, primitives and documented components that keep a hundred screens speaking one language.

02

Interface Engineering

React and Next.js builds where the interaction model is designed with the markup, not bolted on after it.

03

Application Architecture

Types, boundaries and data flow sketched before code, so the next feature plugs in without forks.

04

Performance

Budgeted Core Web Vitals, streamed rendering and images handled like engineering, not decoration.

05

Motion & Interaction

Scroll choreography and micro-feedback measured in milliseconds, never in vibes.

06

Delivery & DX

CI, preview environments and typechecked pipelines that make shipping the boring default.

03 / Methodology

07 steps · numbered

Seven steps. No alchemy.

Process in numbered rows — each one prefixed, time-boxed and verifiable before the next unlocks.

M/01

Brief & constraints

The brief becomes a numbered spec: scope, budget, risks. Anything not on the list is out of scope until it is re-numbered.

M/02

System map

Pages, components and data contracts mapped on paper first — the cheapest place in the process to delete a feature.

M/03

Design language

Type scale, palette and grid locked as tokens before screens. The system is a product; screens are instances.

M/04

Build the skeleton

Routes, layout and empty states first. The shell runs against mocked data in the first week.

M/05

Wire real data

Contracts go live one endpoint at a time, each verified against the map from step 02.

M/06

Verify the evidence

Types, tests and performance checks measured with numbers. If it is not measurable, it is not done.

M/07

Ship & observe

Deploy behind flags, watch the dashboards, and fold what was learned back into the system.
